news_intelligence.title: Blackstone stake buy to boost IIFL Finance's capital needs: Fitch Ratings
news_intelligence.summary:
Blackstone's plan to acquire a 16 per cent stake in IIFL Finance will support the Indian firm's growth capital with an unlikely shift in IIFL's business model, which focuses on secured loans, Fitch Ratings said on Thursday. Fitch said with the investment, Blackstone would effectively become IIFL Finance's main private-equity shareholder. Fitch believes that the refreshed shareholder and board composition could alter IIFL's business strategy, risk appetite and growth trajectory. However, the significant injection of capital and foreign investment supports Indian financial institutions' capital and funding flexibility. Earlier this month, the board of IIFL Finance approved a plan to raise Rs 6,414 crore through a preferential issue. This included Rs 5,000 crore investment from Blackstone and Rs 1,264 crore by the company's promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman, besides Rs 150 crore from Anchorage Capital.
